name: Thomas Cromwell
contribution: An English statesman and lawyer who served as chief minister to King Henry VIII from 1534 until mid-1540, at which time he was beheaded on Henry's orders, a loss the King would later regret.
legacy: This person was one of the most powerful proponents of the English Reformation.
image_credit: Hans Holbein the Younger · Public domain

checks.lead: Thomas Cromwell, 1st Earl of Essex (; c. 1485 – 28 July 1540) was an English statesman and lawyer who served as chief minister to King Henry VIII from 1534 until mid-1540, at which time he was beheaded on Henry's orders, a loss the King would later regret.
